name: What renovation questions should I ask a multifamily contractor before signing?

mainEntity.name: Which questions help reveal whether a contractor is experienced with occupied multifamily work in Los Angeles?
mainEntity.text: Which questions help reveal whether a contractor is experienced with occupied multifamily work in Los Angeles?

acceptedAnswer.text: A strong multifamily contractor should be able to explain how they work around tenants, how they structure phasing, and how they manage permit-driven delays. Ask about jobsite protection, dust control, utility coordination, and the process for handling hidden issues once demolition begins. It also helps to ask for specific examples of occupied buildings, not just luxury single-family homes. The contractor’s answers should show that they understand logistics, communication, and compliance, not just finishes. If they give vague answers about schedule, permits, or tenant coordination, that is a warning sign. Multifamily work is much more about process control than simple construction skill.
acceptedAnswer.description: Ask how they handle occupied-unit phasing, permits, tenant communication, inspections, hidden conditions, and budget contingencies. Also ask for examples of similar Los Angeles multifamily projects and how they managed schedule disruptions. A contractor with the right experience should explain the plan clearly and specifically.
